Catch2 2.13.10 is vendored as its official single header to permit offline builds.

- Source: https://github.com/catchorg/Catch2/tree/v2.13.10
- Header: `catch2/catch.hpp`
- License: `catch2/LICENSE.txt` (Boost Software License 1.0)

Catch2 is used only by the test executable. The engine library has no third-party dependencies.
